description: This file defines an API interface for wizard-related operations in a web UI, including fetching wizard info, submitting configurations, skipping wizard steps, and managing agent onboarding and status. It includes functions for transforming data between different formats and handles mock data for development environment.

methods.name: getWizardInfo
methods.description: Fetches wizard configuration data, using mock data in development environment.

methods.name: transformWizardDataToConfig
methods.description: Converts WizardData into a partial WizardConfig object.

methods.name: submitWizardConfig
methods.description: Submits the wizard configuration to the backend or mocks it in development.

methods.name: skipWizard
methods.description: Skips the wizard step, either via API or mock response.

methods.name: startAgentOnboarding
methods.description: Initiates agent onboarding process with specified method.

methods.name: getAgentStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current status of agent onboarding, with mock data in development.

methods.name: completeAgentSetup
methods.description: Completes the agent setup process, with mock logging in development.
